# target=local-loopback

table task_authorizations: owner=postgres

column tasks #10 owner text GENERATED (raci ->> 'r'::text)

column tasks #20 linear_id text
column tasks #21 linear_status text
column tasks #22 search tsvector GENERATED to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, ((COALESCE(title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(description, ''::text)))
column tasks #23 note text
column tasks #24 scope_hash text
column tasks #25 authorization_id bigint
column tasks #26 needs_reauthorization boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
constraint proposals.proposals_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint proposals.proposals_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['needs_authorization'::text, 'authorized'::text, 'bounced'::text, 'denied'::text])))
constraint proposals.proposals_task_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES public.tasks(id)
constraint task_auth_config.task_auth_config_id_check: CHECK ((id = 1))
constraint task_auth_config.task_auth_config_justin_tier_source_check: CHECK ((justin_tier_source = ANY (ARRAY['lucas_relay'::text, 'justin_signin'::text])))
constraint task_auth_config.task_auth_config_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint task_authorizations.task_authorizations_kind_check: CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['authorization'::text, 'acceptance'::text])))
constraint task_authorizations.task_authorizations_note_check: CHECK (((char_length(btrim(note)) >= 1) AND (char_length(btrim(note)) <= 600)))
constraint task_authorizations.task_authorizations_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint task_authorizations.task_authorizations_source_check: CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['lucas_relay'::text, 'justin_signin'::text, 'migration_006'::text])))
constraint task_authorizations.task_authorizations_tier_check: CHECK ((tier = ANY (ARRAY['lucas'::text, 'justin'::text, 'backfill'::text])))
constraint task_history.task_history_note_max_600: CHECK ((char_length(note) <= 600))
constraint task_history.task_history_op_check: CHECK ((op = ANY (ARRAY['insert'::text, 'update'::text])))
constraint task_history.task_history_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint tasks.tasks_acceptance_addressed: CHECK (((status <> 'needs_acceptance'::text) OR (addressed_to IS NOT NULL)))
constraint tasks.tasks_addressed_to_shape: CHECK (((addressed_to IS NULL) OR (addressed_to ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$'::text)))
constraint tasks.tasks_backlog_needs_review_date: CHECK (((status <> 'backlog'::text) OR (needed_by IS NOT NULL)))
constraint tasks.tasks_closed_needs_note: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['done'::text, 'decided_against'::text])) OR ((COALESCE(btrim(closing_note), ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraint tasks.tasks_description_check: CHECK ((char_length(description) <= 600))
constraint tasks.tasks_justin_needs_date: CHECK (((lower(addressed_to) IS DISTINCT FROM 'justin'::text) OR (needed_by IS NOT NULL)))
constraint tasks.tasks_note_max_600: CHECK ((char_length(note) <= 600))
constraint tasks.tasks_one_owner: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((raci -> 'r'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (btrim((raci ->> 'r'::text)) <> ''::text)), false))
constraint tasks.tasks_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint tasks.tasks_signed_needs_ref: CHECK (((signed_at IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(btrim(signed_ref), ''::text) <> ''::text)))
constraint tasks.tasks_status_allowed: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['backlog'::text, 'proposed'::text, 'open'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'needs_acceptance'::text, 'done'::text, 'decided_against'::text])))
constraint tasks.tasks_title_max_80: CHECK ((char_length(title) <= 80))
index proposals.proposals_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX proposals_pkey ON public.proposals USING btree (id)
index task_auth_config.task_auth_config_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_auth_config_pkey ON public.task_auth_config USING btree (id)
index task_authorizations.task_authorizations_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_authorizations_pkey ON public.task_authorizations USING btree (id)
index task_authorizations.task_authorizations_task_id_id_idx: CREATE INDEX task_authorizations_task_id_id_idx ON public.task_authorizations USING btree (task_id, id)
index task_history.task_history_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_history_pkey ON public.task_history USING btree (id)
index task_history.task_history_task_id_id_idx: CREATE INDEX task_history_task_id_id_idx ON public.task_history USING btree (task_id, id)
index tasks.tasks_addressed_to_status_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_addressed_to_status_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (addressed_to, status)
index tasks.tasks_closed_at_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_closed_at_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (closed_at)
index tasks.tasks_linear_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_linear_id_key ON public.tasks USING btree (linear_id)
index tasks.tasks_owner_status_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_owner_status_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (owner, status)
index tasks.tasks_parent_id_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_parent_id_idx ON public.tasks USING btree (parent_id)
index tasks.tasks_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON public.tasks USING btree (id)
index tasks.tasks_search_idx: CREATE INDEX tasks_search_idx ON public.tasks USING gin (search)
index tasks.tasks_short_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_short_id_key ON public.tasks USING btree (short_id)
trigger task_authorizations.task_authorizations_after_insert: CREATE TRIGGER task_authorizations_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.task_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.task_authorizations_after_insert() [enabled=A]
trigger task_authorizations.task_authorizations_before_insert: CREATE TRIGGER task_authorizations_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.task_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.task_authorizations_before_insert() [enabled=A]
trigger task_authorizations.task_authorizations_refuse_change: CREATE TRIGGER task_authorizations_refuse_change BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.task_authorizations FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public.task_authorizations_refuse_change() [enabled=A]
trigger task_history.task_history_guard_insert: CREATE TRIGGER task_history_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.task_history FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.task_history_guard_insert() [enabled=A]
trigger task_history.task_history_refuse_change: CREATE TRIGGER task_history_refuse_change BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.task_history FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public.task_history_refuse_change() [enabled=A]
trigger tasks.tasks_after_write: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.tasks_after_write() [enabled=A]
trigger tasks.tasks_before_write: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.tasks_before_write() [enabled=A]
trigger tasks.tasks_refuse_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_refuse_delete BEFORE DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON public.tasks FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public.tasks_refuse_delete() [enabled=A]
